readmeExcerpt: This sample demonstrates the database-per-service pattern on Oracle AI Database with a simple cross-service workflow: **course registration checks**.
highlights: students/: student profile and completed-course history in studentpdb
courses/: course catalog, prerequisites, and term offerings in coursepdb
sample/: command-line runner and end-to-end test that compose data from both services over HTTP
